long_biography.plain_text:
Italian sailing administrator Filippo Faruffini promoted the GP42 class around close competition and manageable costs. He favoured stable rules that let teams choose designers and builders while racing without handicap calculations. Early competition provided practical tests for refining the class, and he wanted its decisions and communications to remain open to all participants.

His public commitments have also included contemporary art. He was a founding donor to I live MAXXI, the supporters’ group for Rome’s museum of contemporary art and architecture. Its members combined financial contributions with personal introductions to museums abroad and shared collecting expertise.
